project.title: MS-analysis of pull downs to elucidate putative transcriptional regulators from phasin and depolymerase genes
project.projectDescription: LC-MS/MS analysis of promoter pull-down assays with crude protein extracts from R. eutropha Re2058/pCB113, to identify putative transcriptional regulators involved in the expression control of PHA metabolism, specifically targeting phasin phaP1 and depolymerase phaZ3 and phaZ5 genes.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: In-gel trypsin digestion with prior DTT and IAA treatment to reduce and alkylate Cysteine-bridges.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: MaxQuant analysis with standard settings including label free quantitation (MaxQuant version 1.6.12.0)
